audit: Addis One master backbone architecture readiness
head: cc4a44f6

checklist.requirement: One canonical Organization master
checklist.risk: None found

checklist.requirement: One canonical Organization Unit master
checklist.risk: Legacy InstitutionOffice mapping still referenced by ~10 classes; unit parent is mutable, not versioned
checklist.recommendation: Retire InstitutionOffice after usage reconciliation; expose hierarchy version with units

checklist.requirement: Effective-dated hierarchy with structural/functional distinction and loop prevention
checklist.risk: Resolver picks future-dated published version as current (F20); publish cycle check ignores relationship type; no as-of resolver
checklist.recommendation: Filter effective_from <= today; add as-of resolver; validate functional edges separately

checklist.requirement: Position is a stable slot distinct from Employee and Assignment
checklist.risk: None

checklist.requirement: Occupancy derived from Position + active Assignment
checklist.risk: availableSlotsForPosition() uses PositionOccupancy rows without fallback while placement uses current assignments; API vacant ignores capacity and status (F10)

checklist.requirement: Position archive preserves assignment integrity
checklist.risk: Soft-deleting a position with a current assignment hides the assignment's position relation (F10)
checklist.recommendation: Block or require closure of active assignments

checklist.requirement: Employee is the canonical person/employment master
checklist.risk: No duplicate staff/personnel master found in app or external-apps

checklist.requirement: User account is not the HR master
checklist.risk: users keeps its own encrypted national_id and phone_number and legacy email auto-matching; no field-ownership rule
checklist.recommendation: Decide field ownership; treat user profile fields as copies

checklist.requirement: Provider users separate from Employee
checklist.risk: No link if a civil servant is also a provider user
checklist.recommendation: Keep separate; decide whether an optional link is wanted

checklist.requirement: Employee number is a business key, not the only machine key
checklist.risk: Separate cafeteria app keys transactions on employee_number only (F3)
checklist.recommendation: Keep employee_number; satellites also store employee.id

checklist.requirement: Stable integration identifiers for organization, unit, position, employee, assignment, card
checklist.risk: Immutability is convention, not enforced; not stated in contract
checklist.recommendation: Publish immutability/non-reuse guarantee; do not add duplicate UUID columns

checklist.requirement: Employee UUID, employee number and card UUID are distinct; card UUID stable across reprint
checklist.risk: None

checklist.requirement: Partner verification returns canonical employee identifier
checklist.risk: Cafeteria skips eligibility because employee id is absent and records eligible/served (F3)
checklist.recommendation: Return employee.id; consumer denies when missing; shared contract fixture

checklist.requirement: QR contains only an opaque reference; no PII in QR
checklist.risk: None

checklist.requirement: Partner verification honors QR revocation and card currency
checklist.risk: Active card with qr_status=revoked returns valid=true (F5, reproduced)
checklist.recommendation: Shared credential-state check across public checker, partner API and eligibility

checklist.requirement: Public QR endpoint returns approved minimal data, separate from partner API
checklist.risk: Holder fields only after OTP; legacy CardPublicVerifyController is not routed
checklist.recommendation: Keep; remove dead controller when safe

checklist.requirement: Assignment is the authoritative Employee-Position relationship with history
checklist.risk: None

checklist.requirement: At most one active primary assignment per employee
checklist.risk: Partial unique index + row locks enforce at most one; not exactly one, not interval non-overlap; concurrent writer test NOT_VERIFIED
checklist.recommendation: Add interval-overlap probe; concurrent PostgreSQL test

checklist.requirement: Transfer changes assignment, preserves employee identity, closes old assignment
checklist.risk: New assignment copies old hierarchy_version_id, no job_description_id; vacancy transfer omits organization_unit_id (F10)
checklist.recommendation: Pin destination in-force JD and hierarchy version; set unit

checklist.requirement: ID card consumes Employee + Assignment context, not an alternative master
checklist.risk: None
checklist.recommendation: Keep print snapshots and replacement chain

checklist.requirement: Specialized modules do not own competing employee/organization masters
checklist.risk: Snapshots in satellites are valid copies

checklist.requirement: Recruitment hires create Employee via controlled onboarding
checklist.risk: Vacancies are internal mobility only; no applicant model
checklist.recommendation: Future governed onboarding command using RegisterEmployeeAction

checklist.requirement: API versioning
checklist.risk: No deprecation/sunset mechanism
checklist.recommendation: Add deprecation headers and schema freeze

checklist.requirement: Explicit response resources, no Eloquent dumps
checklist.risk: Verification/eligibility/settlement responses are ad hoc arrays

checklist.requirement: API authorization requires correct principal, scope and resource policy
checklist.risk: provider:access or * satisfies every scope; non-application principals skip the gate; plain user reads any employee (F1, reproduced)
checklist.recommendation: Remove wildcard aliases on master routes; require supported principal

checklist.requirement: Partner access bounded by organization
checklist.risk: Every grant is city-wide (F2)

checklist.requirement: Machine-to-machine identity separate from human accounts
checklist.risk: Provider-service routes call hasRole() and 500 for application tokens; they bypass the application gate and logs (F16)
checklist.recommendation: Move provider routes onto the application gate with provider binding

checklist.requirement: Machine principal can run service eligibility
checklist.risk: check(?User $actor) TypeError for ExternalApplication (F4, reproduced)

checklist.requirement: OAuth 2.0 client credentials
checklist.risk: Sanctum only; acceptable for bounded deployment

checklist.requirement: Least-privilege scopes
checklist.risk: Scope set is good; wildcard undermines it; basic_read embeds assignment data

checklist.requirement: Independent partner credentials and revocation; no shared global token
checklist.risk: No automated rotation

checklist.requirement: Rate limiting per client, distributed
checklist.risk: Backed by default cache store (database/file); multi-node needs shared store

checklist.requirement: Idempotent integration writes
checklist.risk: Optional, non-atomic, no fingerprint (F6)

checklist.requirement: Offline sync durable and bounded
checklist.risk: Verifies but never records; no max batch; provider scope skipped (F7, F16)
checklist.recommendation: Record or rename verify-only; cap batch

checklist.requirement: OpenAPI / machine-readable contracts
checklist.risk: Markdown only; consumer mocks drift (F3)

checklist.requirement: Consistent error contract without stack traces
checklist.risk: Six error shapes; DomainException message passthrough

checklist.requirement: Request correlation across API, audit and logs
checklist.risk: Audit writer generates a fresh request_id; api_request_logs lacks correlation id

checklist.requirement: External API access auditable without sensitive payloads
checklist.risk: Route templates logged, no bodies (good); not logged for provider routes or user tokens

checklist.requirement: Incremental sync with cursors and tombstones
checklist.risk: updated_after + offset; nested changes missed; soft-deleted rows vanish (F8)
checklist.recommendation: Change journal with ordered cursor and tombstones

checklist.requirement: No generic partner CRUD on master data
checklist.risk: None
checklist.recommendation: Keep; future writes as governed commands

checklist.requirement: Historical as-of reads (assignment, structure, JD)
checklist.risk: Cannot answer where an employee was assigned on date Y via API
checklist.recommendation: Add after transfer context is pinned

checklist.requirement: Durable master-data events / outbox
checklist.risk: Only communication broadcasts and backup alerts; no employee/assignment/card events reach partners (F9)

checklist.requirement: Signed webhooks with retry, history, dead letter, replay, secret rotation
checklist.risk: callback_url stored but nothing sends to it

checklist.requirement: Events dispatched after commit
checklist.risk: Existing events use afterCommit; queue after_commit=false globally
checklist.recommendation: New integration jobs must use outbox/afterCommit

checklist.requirement: Partner outage does not roll back domain writes
checklist.risk: No synchronous partner dispatch exists

checklist.requirement: National ID encrypted, not an integration key, not serialized
checklist.risk: Accessor accepts legacy plaintext on decrypt failure; remediation completeness NOT_VERIFIED
checklist.recommendation: Verify all rows encrypted, then remove fallback

checklist.requirement: Private phone and personal fields not exposed by API
checklist.risk: Employee phone/email/address/DOB unencrypted at rest; audit copies them (F13)
checklist.recommendation: Minimize audit copies; decide at-rest policy

checklist.requirement: Media URLs authorized and short-lived
checklist.risk: Unsigned public /storage/ photo URL; broken for private photos, world-readable for legacy (F17)

checklist.requirement: CORS: no wildcard with credentials
checklist.risk: Idempotency-Key and X-Request-ID not allowed/exposed

checklist.requirement: Stateless multi-node readiness (sessions, cache, uploads, queues, scheduler)
checklist.risk: Supported in config; local defaults are node-local; scheduler uses onOneServer
checklist.recommendation: Shared cache/lock store and object storage in deployment

checklist.requirement: Identity lookups indexed
checklist.risk: Index paths proven on 27-row dataset only

checklist.requirement: Unbounded queries absent from request paths
checklist.risk: No ::all() on masters; structure endpoint loads all units uncapped; offline batch unbounded

checklist.requirement: 3,000,000 employee readiness measured
checklist.risk: Largest measured dataset 220,000 employees (7% of target)

checklist.requirement: No external direct database coupling
checklist.risk: Infrastructure DB grants NOT_VERIFIED

checklist.requirement: Settlement and entitlement correctness on provider API
checklist.risk: Period ignored (F18); first entitlement without active/date filter (F19)
checklist.recommendation: Filter by period and active entitlement

checklist.requirement: Backup / PITR / restore drill for master data
checklist.risk: Runbooks exist; no drill evidence

checklist.requirement: Data governance: owner, steward, change authority per master
checklist.risk: Not recorded in repository

checklist.requirement: Partner onboarding governance (purpose, fields, expiry, contact, revocation)
checklist.risk: Technical registration exists; purpose/field approval not modeled
checklist.recommendation: Add approved purpose and field set to application record

checklist.requirement: Data retention policy for master history and API logs
checklist.risk: Config excludes master history from pruning; legal schedule absent

checklist.requirement: Dependency vulnerabilities
checklist.risk: composer clean; npm 2 critical (shell-quote via concurrently), 1 high (source-map-js), dev tooling

findings.summary: provider:access/* token bypasses master-data scopes and gate
Cafeteria skips eligibility because verification omits employee UUID
Revoked QR accepted by partner verification
No partner organization restriction
Eligibility TypeError for application principal
Non-atomic optional idempotency; satellite lacks unique key
Offline sync verifies without recording; unbounded batch
No change cursor, tombstones or historical contract
No durable master events or webhook delivery
Capacity disagreement, archive guard, transfer context
Shared topology, 3M load and recovery unproven
npm critical/high advisories
Provider-service routes unusable by application tokens and bypass gate
Unsigned public storage photo URL in partner verification
Audit PII copies, correlation mismatch
Error/enum/ISO rules, OpenAPI, consumer tests
Settlement API ignores period
First entitlement picked without active/date filter
Future-dated hierarchy version treated as current
OAuth federation, replicas, extraction when justified
